facts.text: Jezero Delta Remnant was deployed at Jezero Crater during Perseverance (Mars 2020) in 2022.

Jezero Crater contains a well-preserved river delta where a river once flowed into the ancient lake. Perseverance explored the delta and found sedimentary rocks with organic molecules and minerals formed in water. The layered structure preserves evidence of changing water levels and environments over billions of years.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Contains sedimentary rocks with organic molecules and water-formed minerals, preserving billions of years of changing lake environments and possible biosignatures.
The Jezero delta is one of the most promising places to search for ancient Martian life, and Perseverance's samples from here are the highest-priority targets for Mars Sample Return.
